default_label: The limit compares dollars against cents

variants.label: Wrong factor of 10,000, so the cap becomes $500,000
variants.root_cause: check_transfer_limit() multiplies the dollar limit by 10,000 instead of 100, so the real cap is $500,000.

variants.label: The limit check is never called
variants.root_cause: transfer() never calls check_transfer_limit(), so no transfer is checked against the $5,000 cap.

variants.label: Wrong factor of 1,000, so the cap becomes $50,000
variants.root_cause: check_transfer_limit() multiplies the dollar limit by 1,000 instead of 100, so the real cap is $50,000.

variants.label: The limit check is given the fee as the amount
variants.root_cause: transfer() passes the fee to check_transfer_limit() instead of the amount, so only absurdly large transfers are capped.
